Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement reviewed the order form and attached a redline (PDF) with a few commercial asks we need clarified before we can proceed:

- Minimum commit ladder: we want the first tranche to be refundable if usage < 30% in quarter 1 (we flagged specific language in the PDF).
- Net terms: we prefer net 60 given internal approval cycles — can Redwood accept net 60?
- Invoicing path: invoices must be routed to procurement@gridlytics.com and reference PO # GL-98765.
- Taxes/withholding: GridLytics will withhold VAT locally for EU shipments; please confirm Redwood’s VAT treatment and if Redwood can provide tax evidence (W-9 included for us to validate).

We attached our redlines and W-9. Happy to hop on a quick call if that helps. Our target is to complete legal/procurement review by end of next week.

Regards,
Liam O'Connor
Senior Procurement Manager
GridLytics

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear redlines and the W-9. I’ve looped in our finance (Kimberly) and commercial lead (Ben) to run a quick review. A few initial notes:

- Refundable tranche: we generally avoid refundable commits because it creates revenue recognition and usage forecasting complexity, but we can propose a compromise: 50% credit toward future usage if the first-quartile usage is <30% (see proposed math in the attached worksheet).
- Net terms: standard for us is net 30. I understand GridLytics’ approval timeline, so we can consider net 45 for the first 6 months and reassess at renewal — need Kim to confirm cashflow impact.
- Invoice routing: fine to route to procurement@gridlytics.com; please confirm the PO number will be included on each invoice.
- VAT/withholding: we can provide tax residency documents; for EU VAT we’ll need to confirm whether GridLytics is self-accounting or Redwood should charge VAT on invoices. Kimberly, Karthik — would you review the redlines and the attached pricing worksheet and push back where necessary?

If it helps, I can set up a 30-minute call tomorrow afternoon to triage open items and aim for a cleaned-up order form by Wednesday.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Nov 2026 10:08:00 -08:00
Subject: INTERNAL: GridLytics redlines — quick legal/finance guidance needed

Team — quick internal note after reviewing Liam’s redlines (attached):

Summary of asks from GridLytics
- Refundable first tranche condition (usage <30%)
- Net60 request
- Invoice routing and PO inclusion
- VAT/withholding compliance and tax evidence

My recommended positions
- Refundable tranche: counter with a credit-only approach (50% credit of unused commit to be applied to future invoices within 12 months). Keeps cash with Redwood and avoids revenue reversal.
- Net terms: push back to net30, offer net45 for first invoice only if they provide PO and faster acceptance clauses; if they insist on net60, require advance partial payment or irrevocable letter of credit (not ideal).
- Taxes: require GridLytics to confirm self-accounting for VAT and supply EU tax registration if they want us to invoice net of VAT; otherwise Redwood will invoice with VAT where applicable. Request their tax certificates.
- Invoicing and PO: accept routing to procurement@gridlytics.com and require PO on each invoice; include a note that late payment interest follows Section 5.3 of the MSA.

Action items
- Kimberly: please evaluate cashflow impact if we move to net45 for first 6 months and advise whether net45 is acceptable (see pricing_worksheet.xlsx for cashflow).
- Karthik: quick review of the proposed credit language vs refundable tranche — prefer the attached wording to avoid revenue recognition issues.
- Ben: prepare a concise rationale for commercial to present to GridLytics on why credit-only is standard and how it delivers equivalent protection.

I’ll draft the counter-redline after we confirm positions. If you’re all available, let’s do a 20-min sync at 3:00 PM PT today.

Thanks,
Aditya

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@gridlytics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Order Form redlines — pricing schedule & invoicing path
Attachments: GridLytics_OrderForm_Counter_20261124.pdf

Hi Liam — thanks for your patience while we reviewed with finance and legal. Quick update and our counterproposal: 

1) Refundable tranche: Redwood cannot accept a refundable cash tranche. Our counter: if first-quarter usage is less than 30% of the committed tokens, GridLytics will receive a one-time credit equal to 50% of the unused portion to be applied to future invoices within 12 months. Wording included in attached counter-redline (see Section 2.1).

2) Net terms: our standard remains net 30. To bridge timing, we can offer net 45 for the first invoice only (one-time concession) provided GridLytics issues PO GL-98765 at signing and confirms procurement email on file for invoicing. We cannot accept net 60 without either partial advance or an irrevocable payment instrument.

3) Invoicing & PO: we will route invoices to procurement@gridlytics.com and will include the PO reference per invoice. Please confirm the billing contact name and the PO # to place on the invoice.

4) Taxes: Redwood will charge VAT where law requires unless GridLytics provides valid tax registration indicating reverse charge/self-accounting; please send EU VAT registration and any tax certificates. We have attached our standard tax evidence checklist for procurement to complete.

Next steps
- If the counter is acceptable, please review the attached counter-redline and return with any final comments. We can prepare a DocuSign envelope once commercial language is agreed.
- Proposed 30-minute call to finalize: Thu 11/25 10:00 AM PT or Fri 11/26 2:00 PM PT — let me know which works for you.

Appreciate it — we’re eager to get GridLytics onboarded.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
